subject.title: fix: keep infer provider workflows responsive and selectable

question: Should `infer tts convert --provider <id>` be accepted as the supported public selector for provider-only TTS backends, with `--model` remaining an optional same-provider override?
rationale: The patch adds a user-visible CLI option rather than only repairing an internal implementation detail, and the protected maintainer signal requires an explicit decision on its durable interface.

options.title: Accept the provider-only selector
options.body: Approve the additive `--provider` contract and retain the documented same-provider conflict validation.

options.title: Use an existing selection mechanism
options.body: Decline the new flag and direct the patch toward an already-supported provider-selection path if maintainers want to avoid another public CLI selector.

recommendation.title: Accept the provider-only selector
recommendation.body: Approve the additive `--provider` contract and retain the documented same-provider conflict validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee supplied the implementation and live proof, so they are the best available contact to clarify the intended CLI contract.
